acceptance_criteria: On mock `3911` the register review form shows the purpose heading, an evidence list from `review_evidence` with nothing selected, a note and only the verdicts listed; Approve, Return and Reject are off until evidence is chosen — verify: open `http://localhost:4990/work/3911`; `frontend/e2e/fixed-assets-reviews.spec.ts` asserts the disabled state and the choices.

Approve on `3911` sends one `POST /api/v1/work/3911/reviews` with `kind:'asset'`, `purpose:'register'`, the option's `target_id`, the chosen `evidence_id`, `expected_revision` and `case_revision` from the read, and an empty note allowed; afterwards the panel is re-read — verify: e2e inspects the recorded body and the follow-up GETs.

A schedule review on `3913` sends `kind:'schedule'` with no `purpose` field; `revoke` ("Withdraw approval") appears only when `revoke` is in that option's `verdicts` and is absent on `3911` — verify: e2e body and button assertions; unit test on the body builder.
Return, Reject and Withdraw with an empty note are refused in the form before sending; Approve with an empty note is sent — verify: unit test and e2e (no request on the refused cases).

A `basis` option (`3912`) draws "Review the dates" and is absent when `review_options` has no `basis` entry; no option is drawn that the server did not list — verify: e2e on `3912` and `3911`; unit test mapping `review_options` to forms.

With `review_options: []` (`3901`, `3904`) no review form, heading or empty gap is drawn and "No review is open for you." remains; with `review_evidence: []` (`3914`) the verdict buttons are off with "No evidence is available to attach." — verify: e2e.
No evidence id appears in any request unless the person chose it; `grep -rn "fileToEvidence" frontend/src/features/fixed-assets` returns nothing — verify: e2e asserts the chosen id in the body; grep.

A 403 hold message on `3916` shows as returned, the form stays and no automatic retry is sent; the client holds no "preparer cannot review" rule — verify: e2e counts requests; `grep -rn "prepared by\|preparer" frontend/src/features/fixed-assets` returns nothing.

Capture a register on `3908` sends `POST /api/v1/projects/{ctx.caseId}/asset-registers` with `case_revision`, `reference`, `evidence_id`; an invalid reference (`-x`) is shown as the 422 field message and sent only if it matched the pattern client-side or the server answered; there is no input for a case id — verify: unit test on the body and the pattern; component test on props.

Record dates on `3912` sends one multipart `POST .../asset-registers/{register_id}/dates` with `case_revision`, `evidence_id`, `asset_id` (one of the "Date unclear" assets), the dates, `fraction_basis` and a `file` part, with no hand-set Content-Type; a non-PDF or a file over the limit is refused before sending, a mock 413 and 415 show the server message — verify: e2e on request headers and body parts; unit tests.

Correct and resubmit on `3915` sends multipart `POST /work/3915/assets/opening-proof` with `expected_revision`, `case_revision`, the `target_id` and `review_id` from `opening_return` (not editable), `reason` and `file`; an empty reason or no file keeps the button off; with `opening_return: null` the control is absent — verify: e2e and unit test.

409 on `3917` re-reads the panel and item, says "This changed while you were working. Showing the latest version.", and does not repeat the press; 422 on `3918` shows the field message and keeps the entered values — verify: e2e counting requests.

A 403 `csrf_failed` refreshes the session once, says to press again and does not resend by itself; a 403 other or 404 shows "This record is unavailable." with no difference; 429, 503 and a dropped network show "Try again shortly" and lock the form until reload or Try again — verify: mock scenarios; unit tests count fetches.

Pressing a verdict twice quickly sends one request; a retry of the same attempt reuses the same idempotency key where the body has one, and a new attempt after success gets a new one — verify: unit test on the lock and key.

No write happens on page load, polling or navigation; `grep -rn "liveApi.POST\|fetch(" frontend/src/features/fixed-assets` shows calls only in the forms' send functions — verify: e2e asserts zero POSTs on load; grep.

`FixedAssetsActions` is registered through F-87's `Actions` slot and renders inside its error boundary; `git diff` shows no change under `frontend/src/features/workspace/`; the F-102 panels and mapper tests are unchanged and still pass — verify: `git diff --stat`; `npm test`.

Against live Django (8030) with a finance reviewer account: the listed `review_options` produce a `POST /reviews` that returns 200 and a changed `review_id`, and a second account without access gets 404 on the work item and on every write and sees "This record is unavailable." — verify: `python3 /Users/Hunchoo/psl-factory-main/delivery/connect/oa.py live GET /api/v1/work/{work_id}/assets 3` before and after; the session `curl` JSON for the write. If no live case is in a review state, say so in `build.md` and list the mock result only; do not claim live evidence.
A schedule with a held status, or any null money field, never shows 0 in the new forms; money stays as F-102 draws it — verify: e2e on `3903`-style fixture with the forms present.

The drawn parts the API does not supply are absent and listed in the PR: "Chidi never reads asset values", the accounting-note text, the phone short money form, the review dates (including the returner's quoted note on the returned board), "Feeds MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTS" — verify: `grep -rn "never reads asset values\|MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTS" frontend/src/features/fixed-assets` returns nothing.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390 against the eight boards (`SCR-55-{desktop,mobile}-{register-review,date-review,schedule-review,returned}`): frame, decide card, note field, buttons and proof row match, and hidden parts leave no empty heading or gap — verify: screenshots at both widths reviewed against `design/screens.md` SCR-55.

Tests exist and pass: unit tests for the review body builder (asset and schedule variants, notes rule), option-to-form mapping, the multipart builders, the locking and the error mapping; `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `delivery/checks.sh` pass — verify: command output.

risk.rationale: Medium. `POST /work/{id}/reviews` records approval decisions under per-record, independent-reviewer authority (`auth`), and three writes are multipart uploads. The basis review is a new flow (product acceptance required) on a contract that changes the review shape (`contract-change`). It moves no money, does not post to the ledger (`ledger_posted` is read-only) and has no restricted payroll data. The decisions are reversible by return or revoke, so it is not high. Under D-180/D-184 it merges routinely, but reviewers should check the authority handling and the upload checks.
